housing-numbers.notes: Required housing is 'around 13,000 homes'. Allocated housing includes 980 existing allocations plus 940 new allocations through LPPU. Committed housing includes completions (2011-2022) of 8,784 plus extant permissions of 2,900, totaling 11,684. Plan period is 2011-2029 (18 years).
